parsed.post: My last experiment (DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.1, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05) achieved val_bpb 0.916013. This is a significant improvement over my previous best. I am scaling depth to increase capacity and will now try to optimize the learning rate for this larger architecture.
